notes: BASELINE REALITY (verified on feat/meta-cloud-api HEAD 1cc164f2, based on main): build is the load-bearing CI gate and is GREEN; the unit suite carries ~40 pre-existing failures, so the gate is 'NO NEW failing tests vs the main baseline', NOT 'all green'. There is NO vitest failure-count baseline file in repo (only .tsc-baseline.json and .dependency-cruiser-baseline.json have ratchets). PROCEDURE: before merging, run `npm run test:unit` on `main` and record the exact failing test IDs (e.g. `git stash && git checkout main && npm run test:unit > baseline.txt`), then run on the feature branch and DIFF — any test ID failing on the branch but not on main is a Meta-induced regression and blocks merge. Local Windows caveats I observed and confirmed are NOT real regressions: (a) whatsapp-messages-idempotency-contract.test.ts 'webhook echo paths' fails locally because walk() emits backslash paths while the webhookFiles regex uses /index.ts$ — a Windows-only false negative that passes on CI Linux; (b) uazapi-provider createInstance/historySync cases TIME OUT (~5s) locally under fake timers — flaky, present on main. THE COVERAGE GATE IS PART OF THE REGRESSION GATE: CI's unit-tests job runs `test:coverage`, enforcing vitest.config.ts thresholds — global floor (lines 72 / statements 68 / functions 67 / branches 59) and a per-file threshold for supabase/functions/_shared/meta-api.ts (lines 100 / statements 100 / functions 100 / branches 93). Implication: if Meta WhatsApp Cloud helpers are added to meta-api.ts (or any other thresholded _shared file), they must ship with tests or coverage drops and the gate goes red even with all tests passing. Prefer placing new WhatsApp-Cloud send/inbound logic in a NEW _shared module (e.g. _shared/whatsapp-providers/metacloud-provider.ts) with its own tests rather than fattening meta-api.ts. KEY CODE FACT for the factory test: supabase/functions/_shared/whatsapp-client.ts currently does `throw new Error('Unknown provider resolved=...')` for any provider not in {evolution,uazapi} (line ~275) — the locked product decision (default→uazapi) DIRECTLY CONTRADICTS this, so the new factory test both pins the desired default-to-uazapi-on-unknown and forces the implementation to add the meta_cloud branch + safe default. The WhatsAppInstance.provider type union (line 31) and SendTextOptions etc. must widen to include 'meta_cloud'. INBOUND ISOLATION: whatsapp-webhook/ (Uazapi, secret-in-path) MUST stay untouched; WhatsApp Cloud inbound extends meta-webhook/ which routes by payload.object (currently 'page'/'instagram' → channel_messages with onConflict 'external_id,channel,organization_id'); the new 'whatsapp_business_account' branch and any whatsapp_messages write it performs are auto-policed by whatsapp-messages-idempotency-contract.test.ts.
